Spirits of greatshield soldiers who belonged to the Fallen Hawks, a band of soldiers that once explored the Eternal City. Stout defenders with a steady guard. Though their methods are somewhat crude, they work well as a squadron, and will attract the attention of enemies or lob ghostflame from the rearguard.

When weakened, they explode to deliver a last-ditch attack. This was the bitter revelation discovered by the desperate soldiers who awaited the return of their lord to the rotted Haligtree. May the flash of our deaths guide Miquella's return.

From the Prayer Room Site of Grace, take the third beam on the right to a small chapel then take the opposite beam to the outer wall. There is a room below the left end of the wall with...

This heavily-armored guardian spirit of the tower attained inhuman strength through divine invocation, and wields a curved greatsword that brings horns to bear on its foes. In the tower, these warriors and their weapons both are spiritual vessels.

whenToUse: No upgrade material is recorded for it. Budget 112 FP for the summon before a fight.

One of the inquisitors casts a tower hex to heal HP, while the hex of the other boosts her own attack power. Inquisitions often perplexed the minds of the uninitiated, and so seniority was viewed as an asset.

whenToUse: No upgrade material is recorded for it. Its 2 bodies split enemy attention.
name: Inquisitor Ashes

A jar-hurling specialist who throws all manner of pots and jars. The warrior jar once told the nameless man this: "You are not yet ready to join the warriors inside. No, you must apply yourself! Better yourself, and one day I will return for you."

Together, Jolán's sword and Anna's claws are as bottomless black, and penetrate the enemy's guard. Jolán and Anna were born in a cold, dark gaol, where they were raised, deprived of light, to be Swordhands of Night. Thus were they cultivated to become the most terrifying masters of their blades, though the burden of the deed left their hearts frail and pliant.

whyItMatters: The summon uses 144 FP. Frost comes up in its description.

Skillfully uses a massive blade made for dismounting other riders, and enhances his already considerable strength with war cries. The sellswords of Kaiden made their prowess known on countless battlefields.
location: Dropped by the Erdtree Burial Watchdog in the Cliffbottom Catacombs, Liurnia of the Lakes.

whenToUse: It levels up with Grave Glovewort. Budget 88 FP for the summon before a fight.

Attacks enemies by secreting sticky threads. The Kindred of Rot are the servants of the Goddess of Rot—servants that have been forsaken.

whenToUse: It levels up with Grave Glovewort. Keep 73 FP spare at the summon sign if you plan to bring it.
name: Kindred of Rot Ashes

The firm, fleshy tubes of the creatures remain rooted to the spot, spraying poisonous liquid over their surroundings.

whyItMatters: No summon cost is recorded for it.
whenToUse: No upgrade material is recorded for it.
name: Latenna the Albinauric

desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of two Leyndell soldiers. Spirits of soldiers each equipped with a spear and greatshield. The soldiers of Leyndell fight their battles defensively. During the Shattering, they were the ramparts that fortified the royal capital.

name: Leyndell Soldier Ashes

Wields a lance enrobed in Death and hurls spectral lances at foes. Lhutel sacrificed her life so that in Death she could continue to protect a soulless demigod until their revival, earning her the hero's honor of Erdtree Burial.
location: Dropped by the Cemetery Shade in Tombsward Catacombs, Weeping Peninsula.
whatItIs: Lhutel the Headless is a summon of 1 spirit, described in the record as "Summons spirit of Lhutel the Headless". Cemetery Shade in Weeping Peninsula can drop it.

whenToUse: Ghost Glovewort is its upgrade material. Budget 104 FP for the summon.
name: Lhutel the Headless
effect: Summons spirit of Lhutel the Headless

They later encountered a nameless Tarnished, who welcomed them as hunting companions. The wolf spirits overwhelm enemies with their agility, aiding the summoner in combat.

whenToUse: It levels up with Grave Glovewort. Its 3 bodies split enemy attention.

desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a mad pumpkin head. Spirit of a mad soldier with a large, brawny physique. Though he has stifled his panic within the dark confines of his helmet, he rampages as if driven mad when agitated by bloodshed or the humming of insects. This mad soldier is all that is left of a broken gladiator.
location: Dropped by the Erdtree Burial Watchdog duo in the Minor Erdtree Catacombs.

whyItMatters: It costs 110 FP to summon.
whenToUse: Grave Glovewort is its upgrade material. Keep 110 FP spare at the summon sign if you plan to bring it.
name: Mad Pumpkin Head Ashes
effect: Summon the spirit of a mad pumpkin head

desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of three man-flies. Two of the man-flies attack foes from the air, while the third spits poison from the rear. Afflicted hornsent eventually metamorphosed into a fly-like form. It was believed that the moment the transformation took place, they were relieved from their suffering.

whenToUse: No upgrade material is recorded for it. With 3 bodies at once, it suits fights where you want enemies pulled in several directions.
name: Man-Fly Ashes

desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a man-serpent. Spirit of a deformed man-serpent that wields a whip of magma. It is said that long ago, the elder serpent that dwelled on Mt. Gelmir devoured a demigod, and the birth of the man-serpents followed.
location: Found in the hall containing several Wandering Nobles and Man-Serpents in Volcano Manor, before the sending gate leading to Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy.

whenToUse: No upgrade material is recorded for it. Budget 62 FP for the summon before a fight.
name: Man-Serpent Ashes

These marionettes are archers, each equipped with a pair of bows. On the verge of falling apart, they are ill-disciplined and attack without warning.
location: Found in the graveyard near the start of the Academy of Raya Lucaria, on a corpse hanging off a ledge accessed via a short tunnel.

name: Marionette Soldier Ashes

The mausoleum is where the bodies of soulless demigods are lain to rest, and these soldiers followed their masters into Death by severing their own heads from their bodies.

Both of them are adept at charge attacks. These soldiers belonged to the ignoble penal battalion, and were buried hidden from the Scadutree's sight.

This spirit takes the form of the summoner to fight alongside them, but its mimicry does not extend to imitating the summoner's will. Mimic tears are the result of an attempt by the Eternal City to forge a lord.

Spirits of sweet little miranda flowers, carnivorous blossoms that feed upon human flesh. They creep slowly, scattering toxic pollen. Vulnerable to fire — do take care of the little darlings.
location: Found behind an illusory wall in Caelid Catacombs.
whatItIs: Miranda Sprout Ashes is a summon of 5 spirits, described in the record as "Summons five miranda sprouts". Found in Caelid.

name: Miranda Sprout Ashes

Wields a Stormhawk Axe in both hands and uses the Thunderstorm skill. A diamond in the rough, deserving of special care lest its potential be squandered. Nepheli Loux truly was a warrior.
location: Can be obtained through Preceptor Seluvis's questline, if Seluvis's Potion is given to Nepheli Loux.

name: Nightmaiden & Swordstress Puppets

His talents were insufficient to be worthy of donning the stone crown, however, and he is only capable of using the most rudimentary sorcery.
location: Dropped by Erdtree Burial Watchdog at the end of Stormfoot Catacombs.

Able to emit the terrible flame of frenzy from his eyes, but has low HP and is frail, unable to take much in the way of punishment.
location: Found on a corpse in the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds, hanging off a ledge on the second broken curved staircase. whenToUse: Ghost Glovewort is its upgrade material. Keep 113 FP spare at the summon sign if you plan to bring it.
name: Omenkiller Rollo

desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of four Oracle Envoys. Spirits of a monstrous band of musicians who employ sacred arts. It is said that when Oracle Envoys appear, playing their pipes, they do so to herald the arrival of a new god, or a new age.
location: Found near the start of Miquella's Haligtree, guarded by several Oracle Envoys.

whenToUse: Grave Glovewort is its upgrade material. Its 4 bodies split enemy attention.
name: Oracle Envoy Ashes

Uses a piercing sword and crossbow to defend his master. One becomes a page merely by accident of being born into obscurity; nothing is asked of ability, talent, or volition.

whatItIs: A spirit ash bringing 1 body to the field, Page Ashes carries the effect "Summons page spirit".

Tricia was once known as a healer who dedicated her efforts to treating Misbegotten, Omen, and all those seen as impure. When her efforts failed, she was their companion as they died, watching over them to ensure that they could pass peacefully, free of pain. A tale akin to the origins of the deathbed companions.

General Radahn's soldiers were all reputed to be masterful warriors, and it was popularly said that the Redmanes knew no weakness.

Take the stairs to the left up to a couple of Imps and it's...

name: Soldjars of Fortune Ashes
effect: Summons three little living jar spirits

desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a spider scorpion. This scorpion is larger than a human, and attacks with pincers and a poisonous tail. Appears some distance from the summoner. This breed of scorpion was native to the realm of shadow, but was far smaller in size. Recent giant scorpions are said to trace back to the Church of the Bud.
location: Found in the Ancient Ruins of Rauh. Category:Ashes Category:Ashes-Shadow of the Erdtree
whatItIs: A spirit ash bringing 1 body to the field, Spider Scorpion Ashes carries the effect "Summons spider scorpion spirit". Look for it in Ancient Ruins of Rauh.
whyItMatters: The summon uses 41 FP. Poison comes up in its description.
whenToUse: No upgrade material is recorded for it. Budget 41 FP for the summon.
name: Spider Scorpion Ashes

desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon a spirit jellyfish. A floating spirit that illuminates its surroundings. Prone to tears, the jellyfish girl searches for her distant home. Will bravely spew poison at foes on her summoner's behalf. It seems her name is Aurelia.
location: Given by Roderika, Spirit Tuner at Stormhill Shack after talking to her. If it hasn't been obtained by the time Roderika moves to Roundtable Hold it is possible to still obtain it by talking with her, though this option might not be offered if the game progresses to a certain unknown point after...
whatItIs: Spirit Jellyfish Ashes is a spirit ash that calls in 1 spirit; the record lists its effect as "Summons spirit jellyfish". Roderika, Spirit Tuner in Roundtable Hold hands it over.
whyItMatters: Summoning it costs 31 FP. The description text brings up poison.
whenToUse: It levels up with Grave Glovewort. Budget 31 FP for the summon before a fight.
name: Spirit Jellyfish Ashes

desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Deenh the Stormhawk. Spirit of a fierce hawk that faithfully rendered lifelong service to the old king of Stormveil long ago, when the true storm raged. Its cries embolden its fellows in battle, and the tempestuous winds that encircle it shred through foes.
location: Found in the Chapel of Anticipation. After returning to the area via the portal at The Four Belfries, go through the previously locked door near the main entrance, and follow the staircase into the upper level of the chapel to find the ashes.
whatItIs: Stormhawk Deenh is a summon of 1 spirit, described in the record as "Summons spirit of Stormhawk Dreenh". Chapel of Anticipation is where it is found.
whyItMatters: The summon uses 47 FP.
whenToUse: It levels up with Ghost Glovewort. Keep 47 FP spare at the summon sign if you plan to bring it.
name: Stormhawk Deenh

desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Swordhand of Night Jolán. Spirit of a swordhand granted light by the Iris of Grace. Wields a sword of bottomless black that penetrates the enemy's guard. Though it was not by the shining star that she had longed for, thus was her Night illuminated. But this was an at times blinding light, and threatened to expunge the Night entirely.
location: Obtained after completing Count Ymir's questline and boss fight and giving Jolán the Iris of Grace.
whatItIs: A spirit ash bringing 1 body to the field, Swordhand of Night Jolán carries the effect "Summons spirit of Jolán, Swordhand of Night".
whyItMatters: It costs 86 FP to summon.
whenToUse: No upgrade material is recorded for it. Keep 86 FP spare at the summon sign if you plan to bring it.
name: Swordhand of Night Jolán
effect: Summons spirit of Jolán, Swordhand of Night

desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Taylew the golem smith. The spirit of the stalwart stone golem who launches his own fists as projectiles. Taylew was said to be the runt of the litter and the first to stop moving, but it was he who became the guardian deity of smithery.
whatItIs: Taylew the Golem Smith is a spirit ash that calls in 1 spirit; the record lists its effect as "Summons spirit of Taylew the Golem Smith".
whyItMatters: The summon uses 138 FP.
whenToUse: No upgrade material is recorded for it. Budget 138 FP for the summon before a fight.
name: Taylew the Golem Smith
effect: Summons spirit of Taylew the Golem Smith

desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a Twinsage sorcerer. Spirit of a Raya Lucaria sorcerer wearing a stone crown. Those who study the Twinsage Conspectus are the academy's elite, capable of mastering the Glintstone Cometshard and Crystal Burst sorceries.
location: Dropped by the Cemetery Shade in Black Knife Catacombs.
whatItIs: Twinsage Sorcerer Ashes is a summon of 1 spirit, described in the record as "Summons Twinsage sorcerer spirit". Cemetery Shade can drop it.
whyItMatters: Summoning it costs 89 FP. Magic comes up in its description.
whenToUse: Grave Glovewort is its upgrade material. Keep 89 FP spare at the summon sign if you plan to bring it.
name: Twinsage Sorcerer Ashes

desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of three vulgar militiamen. Spirits of the vulgar militia who wield long-hafted, serrated hatchets. These brutal weapons are particularly effective at causing blood loss to opponents. In the Lands Between, the small were scorned, and so they formed their vulgar militia as a means to make a living, albeit in ignominy.
location: Found in the Auriza Hero's Grave. At the bottom of the hallway with the two chariots, drop down to the wooden beams below and head north to a room containing a statue. Go through the corridor behind the statue and to the right.
whatItIs: Vulgar Militia Ashes is a summon of 3 spirits, described in the record as "Summons three vulgar Militia spirits". It is an enemy drop.
whyItMatters: It costs 70 FP to summon. The description text brings up blood loss.
whenToUse: Grave Glovewort is its upgrade material. Its 3 bodies split enemy attention.
name: Vulgar Militia Ashes

desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of five wandering nobles. The spirits of nobles who, after death, now wander the Lands Between. Surely they were in search of something once—but whatever it was has long been forgotten.
location: Found on a corpse in Stormfoot Catacombs, in a dead-end room guarded by Imps.
whatItIs: Wandering Noble Ashes is a spirit ash that calls in 5 spirits; the record lists its effect as "Summons five wandering noble spirits". Corpse loot at Stormfoot Catacombs.
whyItMatters: The summon uses 28 FP.
whenToUse: Grave Glovewort is its upgrade material. Its 5 bodies split enemy attention.
name: Wandering Noble Ashes

desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a warhawk. Spirit of a Stormveil warhawk, the talons of which have been sliced off so that razor-fine swords could be grafted in their place. With its lord vanquished, and its wings wounded, the hawk perished as it solemnly gazed at its former home. The storm is a warhawk's cradle.
location: Obtained in Weeping Peninsula, just north of the Church of Pilgrimage. This is the reward for finding the location depicted on the "Prophecy" Painting, and as such, the painting item must have already been obtained from the sideroom to the big courtyard near the Liftside Chamber Site of Grace in...
whatItIs: Warhawk Ashes is a summon of 1 spirit, described in the record as "Summons warhawk spirit". The record places it in Weeping Peninsula.
whyItMatters: It costs 52 FP to summon.
whenToUse: It levels up with Grave Glovewort. Budget 52 FP for the summon.
name: Warhawk Ashes

desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a winged misbegotten. A spirit with the aspect of wings which takes flight to loose arrows from its bow. The misbegotten are held to be a punishment for making contact with the Crucible, and from birth they are treated as slaves, or worse.
location: Unsightly Catacombs, on the bottom level of a hall with lots of dead Misbegotten on the ground around it.
whatItIs: Winged Misbegotten Ashes is a summon of 1 spirit, described in the record as "Summons winged misbegotten spirit".
whyItMatters: Summoning it costs 37 FP. Its in-game description mentions bows and arrows.
whenToUse: It levels up with Grave Glovewort. Budget 37 FP for the summon before a fight.
name: Winged Misbegotten Ashes
